02

Your home

Your family's comfort zone

Whether you have an existing home or you're building the home of your dreams, insulating with MILEX™ will provide your family with continuous comfort during the hottest summer days or through the coldest winter nights.

Put your mind at ease about what goes into your attic. MILEX™ is made from naturally grown ingredients, free of potentially harmful polymers, virtually dust-free, and non-toxic, non-irritant.

Traditional insulation

  • Shrinks over time
  • Needs periodic replacement
  • Contains chemical polymers

MILEX™ Thermal MAX®

  • Resists shrinking and settling
  • One-time installation
  • 100% natural ingredients
  • Lifetime warranty included
03

Long-term savings

Reduce the need to re-insulate

Since the majority of heating and cooling loss is experienced through the attic, it's recommended you "re-fresh" your attic insulation periodically to maintain maximum efficiency levels.

With MILEX™'s exclusive Thermal Puff™ technology, that changes. MILEX™ resists shrinking, sagging, and settling far better than traditional materials, significantly reducing or even eliminating the need to re-fresh or re-insulate the attic.

This could translate into years of energy savings and lower insulation maintenance costs.

04

R-value guide

How much insulation do I need?

Based on recommendations from the US Department of Energy and the International Energy Conservation Code. Requirements vary by climate zone and jurisdiction; generally R-38 to R-49 in Texas, R-30 to R-49 in Oklahoma.

Zone 1R-30
Zone 2R-38
Zone 3R-38
Zone 4R-49
Zone 5R-49

R-values tested per ASTM C518. Actual performance varies by installation.
